title: British Columbia, Canada (starter profile)
note: Starter profile for British Columbia. Health services in Canada are organised by province, so warning signs are kept per province. Emergency numbers and warning signs (transcribed from HealthLink BC) are filled in. To be discussed and maintained by a community in this region.

emergency.message: Call 9-1-1 anytime you think you may need emergency care. If you are unsure if a health concern is an emergency, call HealthLink BC at 8-1-1 for advice.
